item.title: Sheetfed vs Web Offset: Choosing the Right Fit for Your Project
item.description: Choosing between sheetfed and web offset printing can make or break your next print campaign. Sheetfed excels in premium quality and short runs—perfect for luxury brochures and rich visuals. Web offset? It’s the speed demon built for high-volume jobs like catalogs and magazines.
